import pytest
from isort.wrap import import_statement

def test_import_statement():
    # Test with single import
    result = import_statement('from foo import bar', ['bar'])
    expected = 'from foo import bar\n'
    assert result == expected

    # Test with multiple imports
    result = import_statement('from foo import', ['bar', 'baz'])
    expected = 'from foo import bar, baz\n'
    assert result == expected
    
    # Test explodes imports
    result = import_statement('from foo import', ['bar', 'baz'], explode=True)
    expected = 'from foo import bar,\n           baz\n'
    assert result == expected

    # Test with comments
    result = import_statement('from foo import', ['bar'], comments=['This is a comment'])
    expected = 'from foo import bar  # This is a comment\n'
    assert result == expected

    # Test with complex configuration
    config = Config(wrap_length=30, include_trailing_comma=True)
    result = import_statement('from foo import', ['bar', 'baz'], config=config)
    expected = 'from foo import bar,
                      baz\n'
    assert result == expected

    # Edge case: empty from_imports
    result = import_statement('from foo import', [])
    expected = 'from foo import\n'
    assert result == expected
